build_DDQDETRHead: build a DDQDETRHead instance with aux_num_pos=4 for dense distinct query object detection
init_DDQDETRHead_layers: initialize classification and regression branches for dense query auxiliary heads in DDQDETRHead
run_DDQDETRHead_forward: run forward pass on hidden states and references to get classification and regression outputs
compute_DDQDETRHead_loss: compute detection loss including dense query auxiliary loss and distinct query loss for training
predict_DDQDETRHead_by_feat: predict bounding box results from decoder layer outputs using predict_by_feat method
